answer: The river holds work receipts rather than names, so the oasis of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The harbor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
